final resp = await http.post(uri); final body = jsonDecode(resp.body) as Map<String, dynamic>; if (resp.statusCode != 200 || body.containsKey('error')) {throw Exception('createSession failed: ${body['error'] ?? resp.body}');} final sessionId = body['id'] as String; print('    [RUS] Session created: $sessionId'); return sessionId;} static Future<String> uploadFile(String sessionId, String filePath, String userToken) async {final file = File(filePath); if (!file.existsSync()) {throw Exception('File not found: $filePath');} final fileSize = await file.length(); final uploadUrl = Uri.parse('$_baseGraph/$_apiVersion/$sessionId'); int currentOffset = 0; try {final checkResp = await http.get(uploadUrl, headers: {'Authorization' : 'OAuth $userToken'}); if (checkResp.statusCode == 200) {final checkBody = jsonDecode(checkResp.body) as Map<String, dynamic>; if (checkBody.containsKey('file_offset')) {currentOffset = checkBody['file_offset'] as int; print('    [RUS] Resume from offset: $currentOffset / $fileSize');}}} catch (_) {print('    [RUS] New session, offset 0');} if (currentOffset >= fileSize) {print('    [RUS] Session complete, re-POST to get handle'); currentOffset = 0;} final bytes = await file.readAsBytes(); const maxAttempts = 3; String? handle; for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {final bytesToSend = fileSize - currentOffset; print('    [RUS] Attempt $attempt: offset=$currentOffset' ' send=$bytesToSend / $fileSize'); final chunk = bytes.sublist(currentOffset, fileSize); final request = http.Request('POST', uploadUrl); request.headers['Authorization'] = 'OAuth $userToken'; request.headers['file_offset'] = '$currentOffset'; request.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/octet-stream'; request.bodyBytes = chunk; final streamed = await http.Client().send(request); final responseBody = await streamed.stream.bytesToString(); if (streamed.statusCode != 200) {print('    [RUS] Request failed: $responseBody'); try {final checkResp = await http.get(uploadUrl, headers: {'Authorization' : 'OAuth $userToken'}); if (checkResp.statusCode == 200) {final checkBody = jsonDecode(checkResp.body) as Map<String, dynamic>; if (checkBody.containsKey('file_offset')) {final newOffset = checkBody['file_offset'] as int; if (newOffset > currentOffset) {currentOffset = newOffset; print('    [RUS] Server offset: $newOffset'); continue;}}}} catch (_) {} currentOffset += bytesToSend; continue;} try {final parsed = jsonDecode(responseBody) as Map<String, dynamic>; if (parsed.containsKey('h')) {final raw = parsed['h'] as String; final allHandles = raw.split('\n'); handle = allHandles[0].trim(); print('    [RUS] Handle OK (${handle.length} chars)'); return handle;}} catch (_) {print('    [RUS] Could not parse handle response');} try {final checkResp = await http.get(uploadUrl, headers: {'Authorization' : 'OAuth $userToken'}); if (checkResp.statusCode == 200) {final checkBody = jsonDecode(checkResp.body) as Map<String, dynamic>; if (checkBody.containsKey('file_offset')) {final newOffset = checkBody['file_offset'] as int; if (newOffset > currentOffset) {currentOffset = newOffset; continue;}}}} catch (_) {} currentOffset += bytesToSend;} throw Exception('No handle after upload');} static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> publishVideo({required String pageId, required String handle, required String pageToken, bool noStory = true, bool published = true, String? scheduledPublishTime, String? title, String? description}) async {final url = '$_baseGraphVideo/$_apiVersion/$pageId/videos'; final request = http.MultipartRequest('POST', Uri.parse(url)); request.fields['access_token'] = pageToken; request.fields['fbuploader_video_file_chunk'] = handle; request.fields['no_story'] = noStory ? 'true' : 'false'; request.fields['published'] = published ? 'true' : 'false'; if (scheduledPublishTime != null) {request.fields['scheduled_publish_time'] = scheduledPublishTime;} if (title != null) request.fields['title'] = title; if (description != null) request.fields['description'] = description; print('    [RUS] Publish: no_story=$noStory published=$published'); final streamed = await request.send(); final responseBody = await streamed.stream.bytesToString(); if (streamed.statusCode != 200) {throw Exception('publishVideo failed: $responseBody');} final result = jsonDecode(responseBody) as Map<String, dynamic>; final videoId = result['id'] as String? ?? result['post_id'] as String; print('    [RUS] Published! ID: $videoId'); return result;} static Future<void> updateNewsFeed(String videoId, String pageToken) async {final uri = Uri.parse('$_baseGraph/$_apiVersion/$videoId'); final request = http.MultipartRequest('POST', uri); request.fields['access_token'] = pageToken; request.fields['publish_to_news_feed'] = 'true'; final streamed = await request.send(); final responseBody = await streamed.stream.bytesToString(); if (streamed.statusCode != 200) {final result = jsonDecode(responseBody) as Map<String, dynamic>; if (result.containsKey('error')) {final subcode = (result['error'] as Map)['error_subcode'] as int?; if (subcode == 1363077) {print('    [RUS] STEP 4: Post already published'); return;}} throw Exception('updateNewsFeed failed: $responseBody');} print('    [RUS] STEP 4: publish_to_news_feed=true OK');}}
